questions.question: 🛋 What is the Crew Lounge?
questions.answer: The Crew Lounge is a place to recover and rest. You will be able to chill, get foods and drinks and calm down from the loud noises at the Con!

questions.question: 📍 Where can I find the Crew Lounge?
questions.answer: The Crew Lounge is located in the room 0-3 in the ground floor, right behind ConOps!

questions.question: ⏰ When is the Crew Lounge open?
questions.answer: The Crew Lounge is open from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM during the convention!

questions.question: 🧑‍✈️ Who can use the Crew Lounge?
questions.answer: The Crew Lounge is open to all Crew members of the Furvester Convention 2026!

questions.question: 📜 What are the rules?
questions.answer: The rules are simple. To show them, use /rules
